changeSet.author: openk9
changeSet.comment: Clear bucket.language_id where the default language is not among the languages associated to the bucket in bucket_language. Such rows could be written before the default language was validated against the available ones, and they leave a bucket searching in a language no client can ask for explicitly.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE bucket SET language_id = NULL WHERE language_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bucket_language WHERE bucket_language.bucket_id = bucket.id AND bucket_language.language_id = bucket.language_id )
